# wix.com

> Wix is a website builder and ICANN-accredited domain registrar that lets any business or individual build their own professional website. By combining design tools, domain registration, and business solutions in one AI-powered platform, Wix makes it easy for anyone to create without limits and scale confidently online.

Wix combines a drag-and-drop visual editor, AI creation tools, and a full suite of business applications (eCommerce, bookings, payments, marketing, CRM, and more) in one platform. As an ICANN-accredited registrar, Wix lets users search, register, and manage 400+ domain extensions — with automatic DNS configuration, WHOIS privacy, and free SSL included. Wix manages hosting, security, and infrastructure automatically. Wix lets users start a site for free, and Wix paid plans unlock a custom domain, more storage, and advanced business tools. At the core of Wix is Wix Harmony, Wix's flagship AI website builder for vibe coding a business-ready website from a single prompt.

## Getting Started

- [Create a website](https://www.wix.com/website-builder): Wix is an AI-powered website builder that lets anyone create a business-ready site from a prompt or template, then customize with drag-and-drop.
- [Sign up / get started](https://users.wix.com/signin/signup/password?forceRender=true): Wix Sign Up is the account registration page where new users create a free Wix account with an email and password.
- [AI website builder](https://www.wix.com/ai-website-builder): Wix AI Website Builder generates a full mobile-friendly site from a chat — pages, layout, text, images — and adds business solutions to refine in the editor.
- [Website templates](https://www.wix.com/website/templates): Wix Templates is a library of 2,000+ free, designer-made, fully customizable HTML5 templates organized by industry and editable via drag-and-drop.
- [Pricing plans](https://www.wix.com/plans): Wix Plans span five tiers — Free, Light, Core, Business, and Business Elite — all including hosting, AI tools, and a 14-day money-back guarantee.
- [New releases](https://www.wix.com/updates): Wix New Releases is a changelog and roadmap listing live and upcoming features, filterable by ETA, functionality, business solution, and platform.

## Wix Harmony — Wix's Flagship AI Website Builder

- [Wix Harmony](https://www.wix.com/harmony): Wix Harmony is Wix's flagship AI website builder offering a hybrid experience that blends vibe coding for websites with drag-and-drop control, plus built-in business solutions, hosting, and Aria.

## Wix Symphony — AI Agents for Business

- [Wix Symphony](https://www.wix.com/symphony): Wix Symphony is an AI agent platform that builds businesses a team of specialist AI agents — outreach, marketing, scheduling, research, finance, and design — that plug into existing tools and proactively run and grow the business from one conversation.

## Wix Headless — Publish Anything You Built with AI, Powered by Wix Business Solutions

- [Wix Headless](https://www.wix.com/headless): Wix Headless is a headless solution that lets AI builders, vibe coders and agencies connect any frontend to a full native business backend including payments, bookings, events, CMS and eCommerce without building or managing infrastructure.
- [Upload website, app, or any other AI-built project to deploy](https://www.wix.com/headless/drop): Wix Headless lets you drop your site's HTML, CSS and JavaScript files, and have it live on a Wix URL within seconds, with hosting and security already handled.
- [Wix Headless CMS](https://www.wix.com/headless/cms): Wix Headless is a headless solution that natively includes CMS, eCommerce, Bookings, Events and Payments in a single connected backend without requiring third-party integrations.

## Website Creation and Design

- [Website design](https://www.wix.com/website/design): Wix Website Design provides a no-code drag-and-drop editor with 2,000+ templates, AI content and image tools, brand controls, and advanced effects.
- [All features](https://www.wix.com/features/main): Wix Features is a directory organizing all Wix design features and business solutions by category — creation, eCommerce, scheduling, marketing, SEO, CRM, analytics, and management.
- [AI features](https://www.wix.com/features/ai): Wix AI Features is a suite of built-in AI tools spanning site generation, text, images, SEO meta tags, email and ad copy, analytics, and the Aria agent.
- [Web hosting](https://www.wix.com/free/web-hosting): Wix Web Hosting is free, fully managed, multi-cloud hosting (Google Cloud, AWS, Fastly) delivering 99.99% uptime, a global CDN, automatic SSL, and anti-DDoS protection.
- [Website performance](https://www.wix.com/performance): Wix Website Performance optimizes Core Web Vitals at the infrastructure level through automatic image optimization, multi-CDN delivery, and real-time monitoring, with a Site Speed Dashboard.
- [Website security](https://www.wix.com/website-security): Wix Website Security is enterprise-grade managed protection certified to PCI DSS Level 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, with free SSL, HTTPS/TLS encryption, and GDPR/CCPA compliance.
- [Website reliability](https://www.wix.com/site-reliability): Wix Site Reliability delivers a 99.99% uptime SLO via multi-cloud hosting, automatic scaling, a worldwide CDN, two layers of DDoS protection, and disaster recovery.
- [Website accessibility](https://www.wix.com/accessibility): Wix Accessibility provides WCAG-aligned tools — an Accessibility Wizard, keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes, heading tags, alt text management, and color contrast — plus accessibility-ready templates.
- [Landing page builder](https://www.wix.com/landing-page-builder): Wix Landing Page Builder creates free standalone conversion-focused landing pages via drag-and-drop, templates, and an AI generator, integrating email marketing, ads, CRM, and analytics.
- [Mobile app builder](https://www.wix.com/app-builder): Wix App Builder is a no-code, AI-assisted maker that turns a Wix site into a branded native iOS and Android app with real-time sync.

## Domain Registration

- [Domain Registration](https://www.wix.com/domains): Wix Domains is an ICANN-accredited registrar that lets users search, register, and manage domains with auto-renewal, free SSL, DNSSEC, and WHOIS privacy.
- [Domain name search](https://www.wix.com/domains/domain-name-search): Wix Domain Name Search is a free real-time checker showing whether a domain is available, taken, or premium across hundreds of TLDs.
- [Domain name generator](https://www.wix.com/domains/domain-name-generator): Wix Domain Name Generator is a free AI tool that suggests brandable domain ideas from a keyword and checks availability across TLDs.
- [Domain transfer](https://www.wix.com/domains/domain-transfer): Wix Domain Transfer moves a domain from another registrar to Wix with zero downtime, charging only one year of renewal and no extra fees.
- [Domain pricing](https://www.wix.com/domains/domain-pricing): Wix Domain Pricing is a comparison table of per-year starting prices across 400+ TLDs, flagging which extensions qualify for a free first year.
- [Free domain](https://www.wix.com/domains/free-domain): Wix Free Domain gives a free domain for the first year with any annual Wix plan, bundled with free hosting, automatic SSL, and WHOIS privacy.
- [Premium domains](https://www.wix.com/domains/premium-domain-names): Wix Premium Domains are high-value, short, or keyword-rich aftermarket names searchable and registrable through Wix for stronger branding and resale value.
- [SSL certificate](https://www.wix.com/domains/security/free-ssl-certificate): Wix Free SSL Certificate is a TLS certificate automatically issued, installed, and renewed at no cost for every Wix domain, enabling HTTPS.
- [Domain privacy protection](https://www.wix.com/domains/security/domain-privacy-protection): Wix Domain Privacy Protection replaces personal contact details in the public WHOIS directory with proxy details to block spam and identity theft.
- [WHOIS lookup](https://www.wix.com/domains/whois): Wix WHOIS Lookup is a free, ICANN-compliant tool returning a domain's registrar, registration and expiration dates, nameservers, and public ownership details.
- [Domain extensions (TLDs)](https://www.wix.com/domains/tld-list): Wix TLD List is a searchable directory of 400+ extensions (gTLDs and ccTLDs) with each TLD's type, description, and per-year starting price.
- [Business email](https://www.wix.com/domains/business-email): Wix Business Email is a custom-domain email service powered by Google Workspace, providing Gmail, anti-phishing protection, up to 5TB storage, and Google Meet.

## eCommerce and Selling Online

- [eCommerce website](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/website): Wix eCommerce is an AI-powered platform for building and scaling an online store selling physical, digital, dropshipping, and subscription products across web, POS, and marketplaces; with Wix Headless, it also powers the store of any site or app built with AI.
- [Online store builder](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/online-store): Wix Online Store Builder is a no-code platform with 900+ templates that creates product pages, a shopping cart, catalog and order management, and built-in marketing.
- [eCommerce features](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/features): Wix eCommerce features span storefront design, cart and checkout, product and inventory management, multichannel selling, payments, analytics, and the Wix POS.
- [Dropshipping](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/dropshipping): Wix Dropshipping connects a store to the Modalyst marketplace (plus DSers, Spocket) to sell vetted products with no inventory and automatic supplier fulfillment.
- [Print on demand](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/print-on-demand): Wix Print on Demand lets users design and sell custom printed products with no inventory via partners (Printful, Printify, Modalyst), with automatic fulfillment.
- [Multichannel sales](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/sell/multichannel): Wix Multichannel Sales lets merchants sell and manage from one dashboard across Amazon, Instagram, Facebook, eBay, Wish, and a branded app, with real-time syncing.
- [Buy now, pay later](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/buy-now-pay-later): Wix Buy Now, Pay Later lets merchants offer installment payments at checkout (Affirm, Afterpay, Klarna, and more) while getting paid upfront in full.
- [Automated sales tax](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/launch/sales-tax): Wix Automated Sales Tax, integrated with Avalara, applies current geo-specific tax rates by state or country to every transaction worldwide.
- [Payment solutions](https://www.wix.com/payments): Wix Payments is Wix's native provider accepting cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Tap to Pay, and BNPL online and in person, with anti-fraud security.
- [Point of sale](https://www.wix.com/pos): Wix POS is an omnichannel point-of-sale solution that syncs in-person and online sales, inventory, payments, and analytics to one dashboard via POS hardware.
- [POS hardware](https://www.wix.com/pos/hardware): Wix POS Hardware is a shop of point-of-sale equipment (POS Register, POS Go, Mobile Card Reader, accessories) with pre-installed software and 24/7 support.

## Bookings and Services

- [Online booking system](https://www.wix.com/scheduling-software): Wix Bookings is an all-in-one booking system that lets businesses sell appointments, classes, and courses, manage calendars and staff, and accept payments in 40+ currencies; with Wix Headless, it also adds bookings to any site or app built with AI.

## Restaurants and Food Businesses

- [Restaurant website](https://www.wix.com/restaurant/website): Wix Restaurants is a restaurant website builder providing commission-free online ordering, online menus, 24/7 table reservations, delivery integration, loyalty programs, and POS integrations.

## Blogs and Content

- [Blog website](https://www.wix.com/start/blog): Wix Blog is a free blog maker with 900+ templates supporting a rich text editor, SEO and AI-visibility tools, monetization, scheduling, and WordPress import; with Wix Headless, the Wix CMS also powers content for any site or app built with AI.

## Portfolios and Creative Work

- [Portfolio website](https://www.wix.com/portfolio-website): Wix Portfolio Website Maker builds a free portfolio from templates or an AI generator that auto-categorizes work into projects, with no-code animations, SEO, and monetization.
- [Photography website](https://www.wix.com/photography/website): Wix Photography Website is a portfolio builder with high-res Pro Gallery layouts, AI photo organization, image protection, client tools, and monetization through bookings and sales.
- [Music website](https://www.wix.com/music/website): Wix Music Website is a builder for musicians offering multi-format music players, a password-protected EPK builder, streaming integration, and monetization through tracks, merch, and tickets.

## Business Websites by Industry

- [Business website](https://www.wix.com/business/website): Wix Business Website is a small-business builder combining AI design, thousands of templates, free hosting, custom domains, business email, payments, SEO, an AI CRM, and the Owner app; with Wix Headless, these business solutions also work on sites and apps built with AI.
- [Hotel website](https://www.wix.com/hotels/website): Wix Hotels, powered by HotelRunner, is a commission-free hotel website builder with direct bookings, online payments, multilingual pricing, and a Channel Manager across 80+ channels.
- [Event website](https://www.wix.com/event/website): Wix Events is an event management platform providing ticketing, RSVPs, interactive seating maps, secure payments, marketing tools, and onsite check-in via the Wix app.
- [Wedding website](https://www.wix.com/wedding/websites): Wix Wedding Websites is a free builder with mobile-friendly templates for love-story pages, countdown timers, gift registries, travel maps, and online RSVPs with guest management.
- [Non-profit website](https://www.wix.com/non-profit): Wix Non-Profit Website Builder is a free builder for mission-driven organizations supporting one-time and recurring donations, donor CRM, SEO, events, and a free one-year domain.
- [Real estate website](https://www.wix.com/business/solutions/real-estate-website): Wix Real Estate Website Builder lets agents showcase listings with photos, video, and maps, capture leads, send quotes and invoices, accept payments, and sync MLS data.
- [Salon website](https://www.wix.com/business/solutions/salon-website): Wix Salon Website Builder offers beauty professionals templates, Wix Bookings for 24/7 scheduling, in-person and online payments via Wix POS, CRM, and revenue tools.
- [Membership website](https://www.wix.com/business/solutions/membership): Wix Membership Website Builder creates gated members-only areas with tiered content, secure login, automated recurring billing, online courses, virtual events, and member rewards.
- [Vacation rental website](https://www.wix.com/business/solutions/vacation-rental): Wix Vacation Rental Website Builder enables direct holiday-let bookings with calendar sync that prevents double-booking, secure payments, automated quotes and invoices, and guest management.

## Business Management

- [Business management tools](https://www.wix.com/business-software): Wix Business Software is an all-in-one suite spanning site creation, business solutions, CRM and AI agents, customer engagement, payments and banking, marketing, and 800+ App Market apps; with Wix Headless, these business solutions also work on sites and apps built with AI.
- [CRM system](https://www.wix.com/features/crm): Wix CRM is a built-in system that captures leads via chat and forms, unifies communications in a synced inbox, manages workflows, sends invoices, and runs automations.
- [Website analytics](https://www.wix.com/manage/analytics): Wix Analytics is a free built-in tool reporting traffic, visitor behavior, revenue, and customer data, with a customizable dashboard, AI-driven suggestions, and mobile access.
- [Business phone number](https://www.wix.com/business-phone-number): Wix Business Phone Number is a dedicated virtual line via Google Voice providing a separate professional number for calls and texts on any device.
- [Mobile app](https://www.wix.com/mobile/wix-app): The Wix Owner App is a mobile business-management app for iOS and Android that lets owners manage their site, track analytics, run a store, and take bookings.

## Marketing and Growth

- [SEO tools](https://www.wix.com/seo): Wix SEO is a built-in suite featuring an SEO Setup Checklist with Semrush, Google Search Console, an AI Visibility tool, customizable meta tags, structured data, and auto-sitemaps.
- [Email marketing](https://www.wix.com/features/email-marketing): Wix Email Marketing is a free tool that builds mobile-optimized campaigns with a drag-and-drop editor and templates, supporting automation, personalization, analytics, and split testing.
- [App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market): Wix App Market is a marketplace of 800+ web apps — Wix-made and third-party — that users install to extend their site's capabilities.

## Agencies, Freelancers, and Developers

- [Wix Studio](https://www.wix.com/studio): Wix Studio is a web platform for agencies and enterprises combining design, development, and multi-site management with real-time collaboration and AI tools to deliver at scale.
- [Wix Studio for agencies](https://www.wix.com/studio/for-agencies): Wix Studio for agencies lets agencies build and manage client sites at scale with precision design controls, responsive layouts, real-time collaboration, and a unified client dashboard.
- [Wix Studio for freelancers](https://www.wix.com/studio/for-freelancers): Wix Studio for freelancers helps solo creators design and grow their business with a responsive editor, Figma import, a no-code CMS, AI tools, and client management.
- [Wix Studio for web designers](https://www.wix.com/studio/for-web-designers): Wix Studio for web designers offers pixel-perfect control through responsive AI, custom breakpoints, custom CSS, no-code animations, Lottie/Spline/Rive integrations, and a Marketplace to monetize templates.
- [Wix Studio for developers](https://www.wix.com/studio/for-web-developers): Wix Studio for web developers provides full-stack control via a VS Code-based IDE or GitHub, headless APIs and the Wix SDK, an AI code assistant, and app-building tools.
- [Wix Studio CMS](https://www.wix.com/studio/cms): Wix Studio CMS is a no-code content management system connecting collections to design for dynamic SEO-ready pages, supporting 180+ languages, with role-based permissions, runnable headless.
- [Wix Studio features](https://www.wix.com/studio/features): Wix Studio features is a catalog of the platform's tools across design, development, marketing and SEO, AI, agency management, business solutions, enterprise, and multi-cloud infrastructure.
- [Wix Studio templates](https://www.wix.com/studio/templates): Wix Studio templates is a library of fully responsive, customizable templates and wireframes browsable by type, industry, feature, and style.
- [Wix Studio Academy](https://www.wix.com/studio/academy): Wix Studio Academy is a learning hub offering courses, tutorials, webinars, hands-on sandboxes, live events, and certifications for designers and developers.
- [Wix Studio Partner Program](https://www.wix.com/studio/partner-program): Wix Studio Partner Program is a tiered program offering 20%+ revenue share, a cut of client payments, Marketplace lead matching, priority support, and a Partner Success Manager.
- [Figma to Wix Studio plugin](https://www.wix.com/studio/figmatowixstudio): The Figma to Wix Studio plugin is a free Figma plugin that exports designs into Wix Studio and extends them with no-code animations, business solutions, and dev tools.
- [Wix Marketplace](https://www.wix.com/marketplace): Wix Marketplace is a global marketplace where users hire vetted Partner experts for web design, development, marketing, SEO, and eCommerce, and browse Studio templates.

## Enterprise

- [Enterprise solutions](https://www.wix.com/studio/enterprise): Wix Studio Enterprise is an enterprise-grade solution offering multi-site management, hundreds of open APIs for DAM/ERP/CRM integration, enhanced security (SSO, audit logs), and a 99.99% uptime SLA.

## Wixel — Creative Tools

- [Wixel](https://www.wix.com/wixel): Wixel is an AI-powered design platform by Wix that turns ideas into images, videos, social posts, logos, documents, forms, resumes, and PDFs via a conversational AI agent.
- [Photo editor](https://www.wix.com/wixel/photo-editor): Wixel Photo Editor is a free online tool that crops, adjusts colors, applies filters, removes and swaps backgrounds, enhances photos with AI, and extends borders, with no watermarks.
- [AI image generator](https://www.wix.com/wixel/ai-image-generator): Wixel AI Image Generator is a free text-to-image tool that turns prompts into high-quality images in selectable styles, offering four variations and export in WebP, PNG, or JPG.
- [AI art generator](https://www.wix.com/wixel/ai-art-generator): Wixel AI Art Generator is a free tool creating original artwork from text prompts or reference images in artistic styles, generating multiple variations downloadable in PNG, JPG, or WebP.
- [Video maker](https://www.wix.com/wixel/video-maker): Wixel Video Maker is a free online tool that builds branded videos from a prompt, image, template, or scratch, with a music library, transitions, and multiple aspect ratios.
- [Logo maker](https://www.wix.com/logo/maker): Wix Logo Maker is a free online tool that creates a unique custom business logo, lets users fine-tune every detail, and downloads it for free.
- [Resume builder](https://www.wix.com/wixel/resume-builder): Wixel Resume Builder is a free online tool that creates ATS-friendly resumes from designer-made templates with customizable formatting and instant download in PDF, PNG, JPG, or WebP.
- [Form builder](https://www.wix.com/wixel/form-builder): Wixel Form Builder is a free online tool that drafts forms via AI prompt, template, or blank page, supporting conditional logic, validation, embedding, and response tracking.
- [PDF editor](https://www.wix.com/wixel/pdf-editor): Wixel PDF Editor is a free online tool that fills, signs, annotates, and reorders PDF pages via AI chat or manual tools, with an AI Breakdown panel.
- [Color palette generator](https://www.wix.com/wixel/colors/color-palette-generator): Wixel Color Palette Generator is a free online tool that extracts a harmonious palette of dominant colors with HEX values from any uploaded image and downloads as PDF.

## Website Templates by Category

Wix organizes templates by industry, and Wix makes every template fully customizable.

- [All templates](https://www.wix.com/website/templates): Browse all available templates.
- [Most popular](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/most-popular): Top-used templates across categories.
- [New templates](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/new): Recently added templates.
- [Blank templates](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/blank): Start from a blank canvas.

**Business:** [All business](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/business) — [Consulting & Coaching](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/business/consulting-coaching), [Marketing & Advertising](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/business/advertising-marketing), [Technology & Apps](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/business/technology-apps), [Finance](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/business/finance), [Law](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/business/law), [Real Estate](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/business/real-estate)

**Industrial:** [All industrial](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/industrial) — [Services & Maintenance](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/industrial/services-maintenance), [Construction](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/industrial/construction), [Automotive & Cars](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/industrial/automotive-cars), [Agriculture & Farming](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/industrial/agriculture-farming), [Pets & Animals](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/industrial/pets-animals)

**Health & Wellness:** [All health & wellness](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/health-wellness) — [Health](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/health-wellness/health), [Wellness](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/health-wellness/wellness), [Sports & Fitness](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/health-wellness/sports-fitness)

**Beauty & Hair:** [All beauty & hair](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/beauty-and-hair) — [Makeup & Cosmetics](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/beauty-and-hair/makeup-and-cosmetics), [Hair](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/beauty-and-hair/hair)

## Free Business Tools

- [All free tools](https://www.wix.com/tools): Wix Free Tools is a hub of free business, branding, marketing, and financial tools including name and logo generators, QR codes, invoices, and pay stubs.
- [Business name generator](https://www.wix.com/tools/business-name-generator): Wix Business Name Generator is a free AI tool that produces tailored company name ideas from a description and checks matching domain availability in real time.
- [Invoice generator](https://www.wix.com/tools/invoice-generator): Wix Invoice Generator is a free online tool that builds a professional invoice with line items, taxes, and a logo, then downloads it as a PDF.
- [Business card maker](https://www.wix.com/tools/business-card-maker): Wix Business Card Maker designs and customizes business cards and orders them professionally printed and shipped worldwide.
- [QR code generator](https://www.wix.com/tools/qr-code-generator): Wix QR Code Generator is a free tool creating customizable QR codes for URLs, text, vCards, WiFi, and more, downloadable as SVG, PNG, or JPG.
- [Paystub generator](https://www.wix.com/tools/pay-stub-generator): Wix Pay Stub Generator is a free tool that creates pay stubs for employees or contractors with auto-calculated net pay, downloadable or emailable as a PDF.

## Learning and Resources

- [Wix Blog](https://www.wix.com/blog): Wix Blog is a resource hub publishing articles on website building, small business, eCommerce, design, and marketing, plus an AI Knowledge Hub.
- [SEO Learning Hub](https://www.wix.com/seo/learn): Wix SEO Learning Hub is an SEO education resource offering articles, guides, an SEO course, webinars, the "SERP's Up" podcast, and case studies.
- [Wix Developers](https://dev.wix.com): Wix Developers (dev.wix.com) is Wix's developer portal documenting REST APIs, the Wix SDK, Velo, CLI tools, and headless guides for building on Wix.
- [Wix University](https://www.wix.com/university): Wix University is an education program offering free courses, certifications, and curriculum partnerships for students and faculty across 17+ countries.
- [Wix Encyclopedia](https://www.wix.com/encyclopedia): Wix Encyclopedia is a free searchable glossary that defines business, marketing, and web design terms in plain language.
- [Web design inspiration](https://www.wix.com/explore/websites): Wix Explore Websites is a gallery of real Wix-built sites, filterable by type and style, paired with template links and design tips.
- [Wix Studio Blog](https://www.wix.com/studio/blog): The FWD Blog by Wix Studio publishes articles on design, development, marketing, and agency insights for creative professionals.

## Trust, Privacy, and Company

- [About Wix](https://www.wix.com/about/us): Wix is a website-creation platform founded in 2006 by Avishai Abrahami, Nadav Abrahami, and Giora Kaplan, serving 300M+ users across 190 countries, headquartered in Tel Aviv.
- [Privacy and Security Hub](https://www.wix.com/manage/privacy-security-hub): Wix Privacy and Security Hub is an informational center outlining Wix's data policies, GDPR compliance, security practices, and a government data-request transparency report.
- [Accessibility statement](https://www.wix.com/about/terms-accessibility): The Wix Accessibility Statement declares Wix's commitment to conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA and describes how Wix tests pages for accessibility.
- [Press and media](https://www.wix.com/press-room/home): Wix Newsroom is Wix's press center publishing press releases, news coverage, and company updates, with inquiries directed to pr@wix.com.
- [Investor relations](https://investors.wix.com): Wix Investor Relations is the IR site for Wix.com Ltd. (Nasdaq: WIX) providing quarterly results, SEC filings, stock information, and governance reports.
- [Careers](https://careers.wix.com): Wix Careers lists open positions across Wix's global offices, including Tel Aviv, Beer Sheva, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Vilnius.
- [System status](https://status.wix.com): Wix Status is a real-time and historical status page showing operational health and 90-day uptime for Wix products and services.
- [Terms of use](https://www.wix.com/about/terms-of-use): Wix Terms of Use is the binding legal agreement between Wix.com Ltd. and its users governing use of all Wix Services and the Wix App.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.wix.com/about/privacy): Wix Privacy Policy explains what personal data Wix collects, how Wix uses and protects it, and the rights users and their visitors have over that data.

## Key Facts

- Wix serves 300+ million registered users across 190 countries.
- Wix offers a free plan with Wix-subdomain hosting and no credit card required.
- Wix offers paid plans named Light, Core, Business, and Business Elite, billed monthly or annually.
- Wix is available in dozens of languages, and Wix sites can be published in any language.
- Wix runs multi-cloud, globally distributed hosting that Wix manages fully.
- Wix was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv with offices worldwide.
- Wix trades on Nasdaq under the ticker WIX.

<script>
  (() => {
    const EXTRA_PARAMS = {
        'x-wix-brand': '', // 'wixel' | 'studio'
        postLogin: '', // destination after login (trusted Wix URL)
        postSignUp: '', // destination after sign-up (trusted Wix URL)
        redirectTo: '',
        targetUrl: '', // destination for all users
    }
    const LIMIT = {
      // desktop: [],
      // tablet: [],
      mobile: ['US']
    }

    const COUNTRY_API = 'https://www.wix.com/wix-platform/mkt-apis/_functions/country'
    const GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = '353985333474-88ga5vak3e1r9jr9pnh4amaj7fa39far.apps.googleusercontent.com'
    const WIX_ONE_TAP_ENDPOINT = 'https://users.wix.com/_api/iam/authentication/v1/sso/login-with-token-params-redirect/0e6a50f5-b523-4e29-990d-f37fa2ffdd69'
    const GET_USER_DETAILS_API = '/_api/wix-html-login-webapp/user/getUserDetails'

    const isLoggedInPromise = isLoggedInUser()

    const fromFactor = getFormFactor()
    const limitedCountries = LIMIT?.[fromFactor]
    const haslimit = (limitedCountries?.length > 0)
    const countryCodePromise = (haslimit) ? getCountryCode() : null

    window.onload = async function () {
      const [isLoggedIn, countryCode] = await Promise.all([isLoggedInPromise, countryCodePromise])
      if (isLoggedIn) return

      const shouldBlock = (haslimit && !limitedCountries.includes(countryCode))
      if (shouldBlock) return

      showOneTap()

      fetchModalLoad()
    }

    // ===== Show the Google One-Tap popup =====

    function showOneTap() {
      const ldSessionId = crypto.randomUUID()

      const container = document.createElement('div')
      container.id = 'one-tap-container'
      document.body.appendChild(container)

      google.accounts.id.initialize({
        client_id: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
        cancel_on_tap_outside: false,
        prompt_parent_id: container.id,
        callback: (response) => sendToWix(response.credential, ldSessionId),
      })
      google.accounts.id.prompt()
    }

    // ===== Send the Google token to Wix (Wix redirects the user) =====

    function sendToWix(idToken, ldSessionId) {
      const fields = {
        idToken,
        ldSessionId,
        authMethod: 'GOOGLE_ONE_TAP',
        ...EXTRA_PARAMS,
      }

      const form = document.createElement('form')
      form.method = 'POST'
      form.action = WIX_ONE_TAP_ENDPOINT

      Object.entries(fields)
        .filter(([, value]) => value)
        .forEach(([name, value]) => {
          const input = document.createElement('input')
          input.type = 'hidden'
          input.name = name
          input.value = value
          form.appendChild(input)
        })

      document.body.appendChild(form)
      form.submit()
    }

    async function getCountryCode() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(COUNTRY_API)
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('couldn\'t reach mkt-apis');
        }
        const { countryCode } = await response.json();
        return countryCode;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching data:', error);
        return null;
      }
    }

    function getFormFactor() {
      const userAgent = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase()

      if (/mobile|android|iphone|ipod|blackberry|iemobile|opera mini/.test(userAgent)) {
        return 'mobile'
      } else if (/ipad|tablet|playbook|silk/.test(userAgent)) {
        return 'tablet'
      }
      return 'desktop'
    }

    async function isLoggedInUser() {
      const urlObj = new URL(window.location.href)
      const baseUrl = `${urlObj.protocol}//${urlObj.hostname}`
      const response = await fetch(
        baseUrl + GET_USER_DETAILS_API,
        {
          method: 'GET',
          headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'include',
          cache: 'no-store',
        }
      )

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('couldn\'t get user details')
      }

      const userDetails = await response.json()

      return (userDetails.success && userDetails?.payload?.guid)
    }

    function fetchModalLoad() {
        const frogUrlObj = new URL('https://frog.wix.com/hls2')
        frogUrlObj.searchParams.set('src', '6')
        frogUrlObj.searchParams.set('evid', '186')
        frogUrlObj.searchParams.set('app_url', 'wix.com')
        frogUrlObj.searchParams.set('_', new Date().getTime())
      fetch(frogUrlObj.toString(),
        {
          method: 'post',
          mode: 'no-cors',
          credentials: 'include',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
          body: '&' + encodeURIComponent('app_url=wix.com')
        }
      )
    }

  })()
</script>
